text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo calls me over the morning
after we
return from a break.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Could you fetch my bag from the
entryway?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You also have my permission to carry it
all the
way to the classroom for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I still feel very sleepy...
which is why you should
make yourself as useful as
possible at times like
this.
